fail_on_assert.description: If true, any assertion failed will through an error in the provider

sns_body_template.description: Template to build the body of the message for SNS notifications

sns_subject_template.description: Template to build the subject of the message for SNS notifications

sns_topic_arn.description: SNS topic ARN to be notified in case of error

current.description: A list describing the current state. Example: a list of instance ids from a data source.

expected.description: A list describing the expected state. Example: a list of instance ids extracted from resources declared in the same workspace.

message.description: The error message if the expected != current

block.description: The `assert_equal` resource compares the two lists provided as arguments, and fails if they are not equal.
